hook.text: Sugar cravings hitting hard? Stop them in sixty seconds with these three tricks.
queries: person craving sweet looking candy temptation
hand reaching for chocolate bar closeup
woman opening fridge late night snack

tips.text: First, drink a tall glass of water with a pinch of salt. Most sugar cravings are actually dehydration or low electrolytes. This fixes both in minutes.
queries: tall glass cold water sparkling closeup
person drinking water big gulp refreshing
salt pinch sprinkling water glass macro
hand pouring water from pitcher kitchen

tips.text: Second, eat one tablespoon of nut butter. Almond, peanut, or cashew works. The healthy fat and protein crash your craving fast and keeps you full for hours.
queries: almond butter spoon dripping rich closeup
nuts cashews almonds macro shot variety
hand spreading nut butter on apple slice

tips.text: Third, brush your teeth or chew mint gum. The minty taste tricks your brain. Sweet foods taste terrible after mint. Your cravings disappear instantly.
queries: person brushing teeth mirror bathroom morning
fresh mint leaves green vibrant macro

cta.text: Save this for your next craving. Follow for more food hacks that actually work.
